raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 145 txn_ids delivered as exact duplicate rows (identical in every column, including batch_id and ingest_ts), so the POSTED filter passes both copies of 137 of them into silver and every gold aggregate double-counts those transactions. Because the copies are byte-identical, removing exact duplicate rows restores the correct data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT DISTINCT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, currency, txn_ts, status, batch_id, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
